meta.title: Submit the proposal with "Recommended Supplier 1 Contact Name" empty
gaps: Start from the specifically configured closed RFQ containing both bids A 100 and B 90.
Award all 10 requested units specifically to Vendor B; the prepared state exposes only one bid/vendor and allocate_award cannot set an award quantity.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Start from the specifically configured closed RFQ containing both bids A 100 and B 90.; Award all 10 requested units specifically to Vendor B; the prepared state exposes only one bid/vendor and allocate_award cannot set an award quantity.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's Master QCS without searching the events list.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed event.
Allocate the available line item to the available vendor so a proposal can be created; the prepared state does not expose the case's specific Vendor B or quantity allocation.
Open the proposal form after allocating the line item.

args.goal: On the proposal form, fill every required field except Recommended Supplier 1 Contact Name, leave that field empty, click Submit Proposal, and stop on the proposal form showing the validation refusal.

steps.note: The catalog has no step that fills an arbitrary company-specific proposal form while deliberately excluding one required field, so perform that form interaction on screen.
Verify the omitted contact name is highlighted with the required-field validation.
Confirm submission was refused and the browser remains on the proposal form rather than advancing.
